lines.text: So we built one, with AI.
PitchPulse streams a fully synthetic match through five stages.
Ingest. A deterministic stats engine. An AI studio crew. Broadcast overlays. And a view for every viewer.
The crew is five agents, each with one job.
The Spotter finds the moment. The Analyst pulls the evidence. The Commentator writes it. The Producer decides what goes on air.
And the Fact-checker blocks any number the stats engine can't prove.
If a model fails, the crew falls back on screen, and the show goes on.
